params.message:
Trials start by themselves, a wave a day

A proposed source waited for a person to start its trial, and hundreds
waited. The Standard sends a proposed source to trial unless its terms
refuse it or it duplicates one we hold, and a trial is read off the
record: the decision is the admission, which stays with a person. The
engine now starts twenty a day, the most important first and feeds
before pages, and stops while 150 trials are running. The desk read and
the morning mail say so instead of asking the desk to do it.

Portal: Bronnen die op een proef wachten starten voortaan vanzelf, twintig per dag. Toelaten blijft een beslissing van de redactie.
